writing-skill.note: Competent, quiet, believable, but familiar beats and a tidy, low-stakes ending; bunk bed motif underused.

baseline.note: Strongest central image (tagged broken things, bike chain); earned, physical ending. Slightly neat and a few over-explained lines.

merged.note: Sharp ledger conflict and specific dialogue; ending is ambiguous and the junk-hauler scene feels rushed.

storyscope.note: Distinctive voice, dry humor, restrained grief; the mystery payment ending lands, though scenes feel slightly episodic.
